items.customer_claim: Two weeks after the breaker replacement the same circuit tripped again this weekend. Either the work wasn't done right or the issue was misdiagnosed.
items.provider_claim: Replaced breaker; tested other circuits; inspection passed. Customer reported trip two weeks later, possibly due to new appliance load (no confirmation of what was plugged in at the time).
items.evidence_summary: Customer indicated refrigerator was plugged into that circuit during the trip ù within safe amperage but heavy continuous load. No diagnostic of appliances performed.

items.customer_claim: The panel inspection took 4 hours and we were told the wiring was 'fine for now' but charged a diagnostic fee of $320. we expected a quote for the upgrade as discussed on the phone. Disappointed.
items.provider_claim: Inspection was 4 hours because of legacy panel (1998) complexity. Diagnostic fee covers the visit, not a quote. Quote is a separate engagement.
items.evidence_summary: Call recording: customer asked for a quote during scheduling. Email: diagnostic fee structure was in confirmation email. Customer states the quote was 'implied'.

items.customer_claim: Furnace still won't start after the visit. House is cold, we have a baby. we paid for the igniter replacement but the system is still failing. Refund or redo at another company.
items.provider_claim: Igniter diagnosed as faulty, replacement ordered. Initial visit confirmed the igniter was the most likely cause but did not exclude the control board. Follow-up scheduled in 7 days.
items.evidence_summary: Customer photo: thermostat reading 60F. Tech notes show igniter part number and ordering confirmation. Visit notes flag 'additional diagnostic may be needed on follow-up'.

items.customer_claim: Bathroom floor is wet AGAIN only 15 days after the last repair. Same plumber, same spot. I want a refund and a different technician next time ù this is the third visit in four months.
items.provider_claim: Replaced supply line and tested OK overnight; customer reported new leak 2 days later. Cannot independently verify cause without site visit.
items.evidence_summary: Photo evidence from customer of puddle under vanity. Service notes show no leak found on 24h follow-up check. Two prior visits to same address in past 4 months.
